name: Fulton County
intro: Fulton County sits in the southern foothills of the Adirondacks, home to Gloversville, Johnstown and the Great Sacandaga Lake. The Fulton County Office for the Aging in Johnstown helps residents 60 and over with meals, home care through EISEP, health insurance counseling, HEAP and NY Connects. Its own wheelchair accessible bus gives door to door rides across the county on weekdays.

name: Seneca County
intro: Seneca County lies between Seneca Lake and Cayuga Lake in the heart of the Finger Lakes. The Seneca County Office for the Aging in Waterloo offers home delivered and grab and go meals, a loan closet, home repair help, health insurance counseling and transportation. RTS Seneca runs public bus service in the county.

places.note: The 3-mile Wildlife Drive lets you watch birds from your car from April 1 to November 30, and the trails have very little elevation gain.

places.note: Accessible fishing, pavilions, boat launches, cabins and a swimming beach are listed for this lakeside park.

name: Yates County
intro: Yates County is a small rural county wrapped around Keuka Lake, with Seneca Lake on its eastern edge. The Yates County Area Agency on Aging works out of the County Office Building on Liberty Street in Penn Yan, and it is the county office NYSOFA lists for older adults and caregivers. Public transit in the county has been changing, so call the agency to ask what rides are available now.

places.note: The park lists accessible pavilions, shelters and showers on the lake.

name: Livingston County
intro: Livingston County sits in the Genesee River valley south of Rochester, from Avon and Geneseo down to Dansville. The Livingston County Office for the Aging in Mount Morris offers home delivered meals, senior sites, dementia care help, legal services and HEAP for people 60 and older. It also puts on Seniorama, and RTS Livingston runs public bus and on demand rides.

name: Genesee County
intro: Genesee County lies between Buffalo and Rochester, with the city of Batavia at its center. The Genesee County Office for the Aging at 2 Bank Street in Batavia, also home to a senior center and meal site, offers Meals on Wheels, Medicare insurance help, caregiver support and the AmeriCorps Seniors RSVP volunteer program. RTS Genesee runs the county's public transit.

name: Wyoming County
intro: Wyoming County is a rural county of farms and small villages south of Batavia, sharing Letchworth State Park with Livingston County. The Wyoming County Office for the Aging in Warsaw helps with caregiver support, home delivered meals, respite, housing and benefit programs such as EPIC, Medicare and HEAP. RTS Wyoming runs the county's public transit.

name: Orleans County
intro: Orleans County is a farming county on the Lake Ontario shore between Rochester and Niagara Falls, crossed by the Erie Canal. The Orleans County Office for the Aging in Albion runs Meals on Wheels, the NUTRIFAIR meal sites, Medicare Part D and EPIC help, and a volunteer driver program for residents 60 and older who book at least a week ahead. RTS Orleans runs the county's public transit.

name: Erie County
intro: Erie County is home to Buffalo and its suburbs at the eastern end of Lake Erie. The Erie County Department for the Aging runs NY Connects, Stay Fit congregate dining, HIICAP insurance counseling and the Telephone Assurance Program. Its Going Places van gives curb-to-curb rides to people 60 and older who cannot use regular transportation, with a voluntary suggested contribution.

name: Niagara County
intro: Niagara County sits between Lake Ontario and the Niagara River, from the city of Niagara Falls east to Lockport on the Erie Canal. The Niagara County Office for the Aging in Lockport offers EISEP in-home help, HEAP, HIICAP insurance counseling, legal help and caregiver programs. Its Senior Medical Van gives curb-to-curb rides to medical appointments in Niagara, Erie and Orleans counties for residents 60 and older.

name: Chautauqua County
intro: Chautauqua County is the far southwest corner of New York, between Lake Erie and Chautauqua Lake, with Jamestown and Dunkirk as its cities. The Chautauqua County Office for Aging Services in Mayville runs NY Connects, adult day and respite, home repair help, elder abuse prevention and a Santa for Seniors program. Public transit across the county is CHQ Transit, the system formerly known as CARTS.

name: Cattaraugus County
intro: Cattaraugus County sits along the Pennsylvania line in the hills of Western New York, with Olean and Salamanca as its cities. The Cattaraugus County Department of Aging in Olean runs NY Connects, Meals on Wheels, case management and a free online caregiver education portal. Some rides are available countywide for medical visits, shopping and adult day care, so call the department to set one up.

name: Allegany County
intro: Allegany County is a rural county in the Southern Tier hills on the Pennsylvania border, with Wellsville as its largest village. The Allegany County Office for the Aging in Belmont offers HIICAP health insurance counseling, meals, in-home services, caregiver support and legal help. Volunteer drivers give rides to residents 60 and older, with at least two days' notice.
